04 · Nigeria Fiscal & Tax Engine

If the fiscal regime is hidden, the valuation is fragile.

NTA 2025, NTAA 2025 and the PIA remain separate legal/control layers. Demonstration settings below are classroom proxies, not licence-specific statutory calculations.

ROYALTY FROM PRODUCTION
—

Indicative first-year royalty on selected onshore converted field production. Daily volume tranches are mapped to price to approximate a teaching case.

ADDITIONAL PRICE ROYALTY
—

Price-based royalty is modelled using 2020 reference thresholds escalated by 2% annually, as described in the NTA schedule.

ILLUSTRATIVE HT / CIT / LEVY
—

First-year tax proxy with simplistic linear depreciation. The correct legal deductions, limitations, allowances and levy base require a proper tax engine.

Tax architecture must have explicit switches

Important: Legacy PPT and PSC structures are not simulated by switching the rate. They require separate engines, legal classification and tax-period rules.

Visible legal/tax checkpoints

  • State the actual licence, terrain, field and hydrocarbon stream before choosing HT and royalty logic.
  • Identify the PIA-to-NTA transitional regime and year of first sale.
  • Maintain separate royalty by production and, where relevant, royalty by price.
  • Map tax assessment separately from cash instalments and statutory return dates.
  • Track payees and money-flow controls under Executive Order 9 of 2026.

Selected monthly / annual statutory checkpoints

Tax / eventIllustrative rule summaryPrimary anchor
Petroleum royaltyMonthly self-assessment return by 14th of next monthNTAA 2025, s.18(2)
Estimated tax returnWithin two months of start of accounting periodNTAA 2025, s.16
Actual tax filingWithin five months after 31 December, relevant conditions applyingNTAA 2025, s.17
Tax instalmentsMonthly instalments / true-up, depending on statutory mechanismNTAA 2025, s.50
Tax transitionNew regime from 1 January 2026; pre-commencement liabilities under prior rulesFederal Ministry of Finance, June 2026
Government remittanceDocument direct Federation remittance / revised NNPC deductionsExecutive Order 9, 2026
05 · Timeline Design & Cash Timing

The model’s clock determines its value.

Use monthly or quarterly detail around drilling, first oil and debt service; summarise annual periods thereafter. Time tax liabilities, receipts and actual cash separately.

FISCAL PERIOD

Calendar year / first-sale logic

For the relevant upstream regime, reconcile model columns to the NTA accounting-year definition and shorter first or final periods.

DISCOUNT FACTOR

End-period versus mid-period

At the same risk-adjusted discount rate, shifting identical flows to mid-year produces a different NPV. Always label the convention.

PAYMENT DATES

Cash taxes versus accrual

When the lender asks for quarter-end cash, taxes paid and invoiced royalties matter more than how expense is presented.

06 · Financing, RBL & Multi-Currency

NPV measures value. DSCR tests survival.

A profitable field can still fail a reserve-based lending covenant or a liquidity test because price, uptime, entitlement or statutory cash payments fall in the wrong quarter.

Debt-service ladder

Debt service equals scheduled principal plus interest on opening debt. This teaching proxy omits redeterminations, sculpting, cash sweeps, covenants and reserve audit criteria.

Three-price, three-currency discipline

Commercial price: invoices and realised field sale revenues.

Fiscal price: regulator-determined values for relevant tax/royalty computations.

Contractual price: may be relevant for legacy PSC entitlements and pricing formulas.

USD model: operating economics and financing.

NGN reporting: statutory and financial reporting conversion.

07 · Assurance & Model Governance

Build the audit trail before you build confidence.

A visible master check is a gatekeeper, not a ceremonial green tick. Test assumptions, payees, formula integrity, tax timing and source evidence before using the output.

    Contemporaneous decision triggers

    01 JANUARY 2026

    Nigeria’s new fiscal administration era

    NTA 2025 and related tax administration reforms took effect for relevant transactions and accounting periods. The transition guidance reaffirms that pre-2026 liabilities belong to the repealed regime.

    FEBRUARY 2026

    Executive Order 9: petroleum receipts

    Federal policy directs specified petroleum revenues to the Federation Account and stops named NNPC deduction arrangements. Model cash waterfall, payees and contractual consequences carefully.

    13 OCTOBER 2026 · NUPRC

    Production above crude quota

    NUPRC reported September crude average of 1.53m bpd and the fifth successive month at or above the 1.5m bpd OPEC crude quota.

    2026 · MODEL STANDARD

    Review rather than autopilot

    Model governance requires evidenced source updates, independent review, licence-specific interpretation and explanation of material assumption changes.

    Dates and source figures above are 2026 context, not inputs to the hypothetical field model. Field models require operator-specific production, price, cost and entitlement evidence.

    Facilitator’s suggested learning journey

    0–12 min · Boardroom problem

    Show the US$61m vs US$38m dilemma. Ask “What must be reconciled before anyone approves financing?”

    12–40 min · Build the architecture

    Use clickable nodes, regime choices, fiscal calendar, and currency policies; challenge shortcut assumptions.

    40–70 min · Interactive case

    Stress price, decline and capex in the live model. Test DSCR and intentionally break the master integrity check.

    70–85 min · Nigerian 2026 lens

    Ask how transition, tax instalments, EO9 payees and current production affect sanction and bank financing.

    85–90 min · Check understanding

    Run the six scenario-based quiz questions, then capture improvement commitments and review responsibilities.
